shared_constraints: Original game art only. Crisp hand-placed pixel art, no smooth vector edges, no painterly rendering, no photorealism. Fixed 3/4 top-down camera, upper-left key light, compact four-head-tall humanoid proportions. Source character frame contract 128x128 pixels and target in-game body height 72 pixels at 1280x720. Low-saturation blue-gray stone dungeon background. Strong silhouettes and value contrast. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, borders, UI captions, or watermark.
prompt_assembly: style_reference_master is followed by one space and shared_constraints; all other prompt values are stored exactly as submitted.

prompts.style_reference_master: Create one landscape visual style reference board for an original 2D fixed-camera action-puzzle game. Show a cyan blessing mage player, a coral-red charging knight, a violet piercing archer, and a compact green minion together in one coherent 3/4 top-down dungeon scene, plus small inset examples of stone floor tiles, a gold diamond exit, cyan haste streaks, red giant aura, and readable attack telegraphs. Pixel-art character proportions are four heads tall. The player must be visibly non-weapon-bearing and read as a support mage. The charging knight must read through a forward wedge silhouette. The archer must have a clearly readable firing axis. The minion must be much smaller. Use a restrained palette: cyan player, coral-red charger, violet archer, green minion, gold objective, blue-gray environment. Telegraphs remain brighter than VFX and background and use shape as well as color. This is a visual board only with no text or labels.
prompts.player_reference: Using the attached approved draft style reference as the exact visual guide, create a landscape pixel-art character reference sheet for the same original non-attacking cyan blessing mage player. Show front, back, left, right, and 3/4 top-down views plus clearly separated idle, move, dash, blessing-cast, hit, and death key poses. Compact four-head-tall silhouette, cyan and white palette, short practical mantle, clear empty hands or a tiny casting focus that cannot be mistaken for a weapon. Keep costume, lighting, body scale, foot position, pixel density, and camera angle consistent across every pose. Original game art only. Neutral dark blue-gray low-contrast background. No smooth vector edges, no painterly rendering, no photorealism. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, panel captions, or watermark.

prompts.character_scale_reference: Using the four attached character reference sheets, create one landscape pixel-art relative scale reference showing exactly these same designs: cyan blessing mage player, coral-red charging knight, violet piercing archer, and compact green minion. Place them standing on one shared 3/4 top-down low-contrast blue-gray stone floor plane with identical upper-left lighting and pixel density. Player, charger, and archer are comparable humanoid height; minion is about 55 percent of their body height. Add the same gold diamond exit and one visible floor tile unit for environmental scale. Keep feet aligned to a common world baseline and preserve each character design. Original game art only. No attacks. No text, labels, rulers, numbers, logos, signatures, or watermark.

scope_note: These are review references, not approved final M3 sprites. Golem, Echo gameplay implementation, environmental hazards, final rooms, and marketing capture remain outside the current M1 gate.
